Getting started is easy: find your nearest Medi-Weightloss clinic and schedule a free assessment.
From there, you’ll come in for a new patient visit where we’ll review your medical history, run
labs, complete a body composition analysis, and build your personalized plan. You can find your
local clinic on our [Locations page][61] or call 1 (877) MED-LOSS to speak with our team today.

carriers. Because our program is physician-supervised and evidence-based, certain services provided

Getting started is easy: find your nearest Medi-Weightloss clinic and schedule a free assessment.
From there, you’ll come in for a new patient visit where we’ll review your medical history, run
labs, complete a body composition analysis, and build your personalized plan. You can find your
local clinic on our [Locations page][61] or call 1 (877) MED-LOSS to speak with our team today.

carriers. Because our program is physician-supervised and evidence-based, certain services provided

* ## About Merz Aesthetics
  
  With numerous innovative products for the treatment of skin, Merz Aesthetics is one of the leaders
  in asthetic medicine. A broad and well-coordinated portfolio of minimally invasive and
  non-invasive skin rejuvenation measures ensures that the needs and wishes of each patient can be
  individually addressed during treatment.
  
  Learn more about the portfolio of products that fuels confidence in every person.
  
  [Read more][33]
* ## Better Outcomes for More Patients
  
  At Merz Therapeutics, we relentlessly pursue innovative treatment and partnerships that aim to
  improve enduring quality of life for people living with neurological disorders. Our clinical
  development programs are designed to help more people benefit from the proven results of our
  heritage products while we seek opportunities to expand how we can serve patients in need.
  
  [Read more][34]
  
  We are constantly working to advance new treatment standards and improve the quality of research,
  education and patient care.
* ## About Merz Lifecare
  
  Merz Lifecare supports people in living a healthy life. Our tetesept, SOS, Zirkulin, Merz Spezial
  and Brooklyn Soap Company products empower consumers to make good choices about their health and
  well-being.
  
  Our brands offer a wide variety of products for health, well-being, body care and natural beauty:
  from head to toe and for babies to seniors.
  
  [Read more][35]
* ## Celebrating 110 years of Merz
  
  110 years ago, on March 9, 1918, the pharmacist and chemist Friedrich Merz founded the Chemische
  Fabrik Merz & Co. in Frankfurt am Main, Germany. Today, Merz remains a family-owned company, but
  has evolved into a global leader in aesthetic medicine and neurotoxin therapy.
  
  The motto of Friedrich Merz, who was born in 1884 in the town of Groß-Bieberau in the German
  Odenwald mountain range, was: “Trust yourself, be different, and invent products that are truly
  needed.“
  
  [Read more][36]

## DAXXIFY® (daxibotulinumtoxinA-lanm) injection IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION

### INDICATION

DAXXIFY® (daxibotulinumtoxinA-lanm) injection is an acetylcholine release inhibitor and
neuromuscular blocking agent indicated for the temporary improvement in the appearance of moderate
to severe glabellar lines associated with corrugator and/or procerus muscle activity in adult
patients and for the treatment of cervical dystonia in adults.

WARNING: DISTANT SPREAD OF TOXIN EFFECT
The effects of DAXXIFY® and all botulinum toxin products may spread from the area of injection to
produce symptoms consistent with botulinum toxin effects. These symptoms have been reported hours to
weeks after injection. Swallowing and breathing difficulties can be life threatening and there have
been reports of death. DAXXIFY® is not approved for the treatment of spasticity or any conditions
other than cervical dystonia and glabellar lines.

### IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION


### Contraindications

DAXXIFY® contraindications include hypersensitivity to any botulinum toxin preparation or any of the
components in the formulation and infection at the injection site(s).

### Warnings and Precautions

Please refer to Boxed Warning for Distant Spread of Toxin Effect.

The potency units of DAXXIFY® are not interchangeable with preparations of other botulinum toxin
products. Recommended dose and frequency of administration should not be exceeded. Patients should
seek immediate medical attention if respiratory, speech or swallowing difficulties occur. Use
caution when administering to patients with pre-existing cardiovascular disease. Concomitant
neuromuscular disorders may exacerbate clinical effects of treatment.

### Adverse Reactions

The most commonly observed adverse reactions are:
Glabellar lines (≥1%): headache (6%), eyelid ptosis (2%) and facial paresis (1%).
Cervical dystonia (≥5%): headache (9%), injection site pain (8%), injection site erythema (5%),
muscular weakness (5%), and upper respiratory tract infection (5%).

### Drug Interactions

Co-administration of DAXXIFY® and aminoglycoside antibiotics, anticholinergic agents or any other
agents interfering with neuromuscular transmission or muscle relaxants should only be performed with
caution as the effect of DAXXIFY® may be potentiated. The effect of administering different
botulinum neurotoxins during course of treatment with DAXXIFY® is unknown.

### Use in Specific Populations

DAXXIFY® is not recommended for use in children or pregnant women.

**Please see DAXXIFY® full [Prescribing Information][14], including Boxed Warning and [Medication
Guide][15].**

**To report side effects associated with DAXXIFY®, please visit safety.revance.com, or call
[1-877-373-8669][16]. You may also report side effects to the FDA at [1-800-FDA-1088][17] or visit
[www.fda.gov/medwatch][18]**

RHA^{®} 2, RHA^{®} 3 and RHA^{®} 4 with lidocaine and RHA Redensity^{®} Mepi, RHA^{®} 2 Mepi,
RHA^{®} 3 Mepi and RHA^{®} Dynamic Volume, with mepivacaine.

RHA Redensity^{®} and RHA Redensity^{®} Mepi are indicated for injection into the dermis and
superficial dermis of the face, for the correction of moderate to severe dynamic perioral rhytids in

wrinkles and folds, such as nasolabial folds (NLFs) and is also indicated for injection into the
vermillion body, vermillion border and oral commissure to achieve lip augmentation and lip fullness
in adults 22 or older. RHA^{®} 4 is indicated for injection in the deep dermis to superficial
subcutaneous tissue for the correction of moderate to severe dynamic facial wrinkles and folds, such
as nasolabial folds (NLFs) in adults 22 or older. RHA^{®} 4 is indicated for injection in the deep
dermis to superficial subcutaneous tissue for the correction of moderate to severe dynamic facial

## DAXXIFY® (daxibotulinumtoxinA-lanm) injection IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION

### INDICATION

DAXXIFY® (daxibotulinumtoxinA-lanm) injection is an acetylcholine release inhibitor and
neuromuscular blocking agent indicated for the temporary improvement in the appearance of moderate
to severe glabellar lines associated with corrugator and/or procerus muscle activity in adult
patients and for the treatment of cervical dystonia in adults.

WARNING: DISTANT SPREAD OF TOXIN EFFECT
The effects of DAXXIFY® and all botulinum toxin products may spread from the area of injection to
produce symptoms consistent with botulinum toxin effects. These symptoms have been reported hours to
weeks after injection. Swallowing and breathing difficulties can be life threatening and there have
been reports of death. DAXXIFY® is not approved for the treatment of spasticity or any conditions
other than cervical dystonia and glabellar lines.

### IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION


### Contraindications

DAXXIFY® contraindications include hypersensitivity to any botulinum toxin preparation or any of the
components in the formulation and infection at the injection site(s).

### Warnings and Precautions

Please refer to Boxed Warning for Distant Spread of Toxin Effect.

The potency units of DAXXIFY® are not interchangeable with preparations of other botulinum toxin
products. Recommended dose and frequency of administration should not be exceeded. Patients should
seek immediate medical attention if respiratory, speech or swallowing difficulties occur. Use
caution when administering to patients with pre-existing cardiovascular disease. Concomitant
neuromuscular disorders may exacerbate clinical effects of treatment.

### Adverse Reactions

The most commonly observed adverse reactions are:
Glabellar lines (≥1%): headache (6%), eyelid ptosis (2%) and facial paresis (1%).
Cervical dystonia (≥5%): headache (9%), injection site pain (8%), injection site erythema (5%),
muscular weakness (5%), and upper respiratory tract infection (5%).

### Drug Interactions

Co-administration of DAXXIFY® and aminoglycoside antibiotics, anticholinergic agents or any other
agents interfering with neuromuscular transmission or muscle relaxants should only be performed with
caution as the effect of DAXXIFY® may be potentiated. The effect of administering different
botulinum neurotoxins during course of treatment with DAXXIFY® is unknown.

### Use in Specific Populations

DAXXIFY® is not recommended for use in children or pregnant women.

**Please see DAXXIFY® full [Prescribing Information][14], including Boxed Warning and [Medication
Guide][15].**

**To report side effects associated with DAXXIFY®, please visit safety.revance.com, or call
[1-877-373-8669][16]. You may also report side effects to the FDA at [1-800-FDA-1088][17] or visit
[www.fda.gov/medwatch][18]**

RHA^{®} 3 Mepi and RHA^{®} Dynamic Volume, with mepivacaine.

RHA Redensity^{®} and RHA Redensity^{®} Mepi are indicated for injection into the dermis and
superficial dermis of the face, for the correction of moderate to severe dynamic perioral rhytids in
adults 22 or older. RHA^{®} 2 and RHA^{®} 2 Mepi are indicated for injection into the mid-to-deep
dermis for the correction of moderate to severe dynamic facial wrinkles and folds, such as

injection into the mid-to-deep dermis for the correction of moderate to severe dynamic facial
wrinkles and folds, such as nasolabial folds (NLFs) and is also indicated for injection into the
vermillion body, vermillion border and oral commissure to achieve lip augmentation and lip fullness
in adults 22 or older. RHA^{®} 4 is indicated for injection in the deep dermis to superficial
subcutaneous tissue for the correction of moderate to severe dynamic facial wrinkles and folds, such
as nasolabial folds (NLFs) in adults 22 or older. RHA^{®} 4 is indicated for injection in the deep

wrinkles and folds, such as nasolabial folds (NLFs) and for injection into the subcutaneous to

deficiencies in adults 22 or older.

## OUR SERVICES

Our dedicated team of experts provides top-tier cosmetic dermatology and personalized skin care
solutions. As your trusted skin doctor, we are here to listen to your concerns and guide you toward
achieving your best skin health.

From routine skin care and preventive treatments to advanced cosmetic and medical procedures, our
board-certified dermatologists provide the expertise you need.

Explore our comprehensive range of dermatological care:

###### [Plastic Surgery >][95]

Our experienced surgeons are skilled in facelifts, eyelid lifts, and reconstructive surgeries,
delivering exceptional results tailored to your needs.

###### [Laser Procedures >][96]

Experience the transformative potential of our laser skin treatment, which combines precision with
safety for optimal results.

###### [Pediatric Dermatology >][97]

Our pediatric dermatologists specialize in treating skin conditions commonly seen in infants,
children, and teens, including eczema, acne, and birthmarks.

###### [Eldercare Dermatology >][98]

We provide specialized care for older adults, including skin cancer screening, infection treatment,
treatment for pressure ulcers, dry skin care, and more.  

###### [Cosmetic Procedures >][99]

Discover cosmetic procedures such as dermal fillers to add volume, reduce wrinkles, and restore a
youthful appearance.

###### [Mohs Skin Cancer Surgery >][100]

This procedure is ideal for people with large or poorly defined basal or squamous cell carcinomas,
growths on the face, scalp, and ears, and recurrent lesions.

güven, güler yüz ve hasta memnuniyetini temel alan yaklaşımıyla, beş farklı hastaneyi zaman
içerisinde bünyesine katarak Marmara Bölgesinde öne çıkan sağlık kuruluşlarından biri haline
gelmiştir.

Aktif International Hastaneler Grubu’nun yolculuğu, 1999 yılında Özel Yalova Uzmanlar Hastanesi’nin
kuruluşu ile başlamıştır. 2010 yılında Özel Yalova Aktif Hastanesi’nin ve daha sonra 1998 yılında

hastanemizin katılımıyla devam etmiştir. 2009 yılında kurulan Özel Kocaeli Hastanesi 2021 yılında
Özel Aktif Kocaeli Hastanesi ismiyle ve İstanbul Bahçelievler’deki Vital Hospital ise 2022 yılında
hastane grubu bünyesine katılmıştır. Bu son iki hastanenin de katılımıyla toplamda 5 hastane 2023
yılında Aktif International adıyla tek bir şemsiye altında toplanmıştır.

Aktif International tüm hastane ve kliniklerinde yaklaşık 2000 kişilik bir sağlık ordusuyla, modern
tıbbın gerektirdiği tüm teknolojik alt yapı ve modern tedavi yaklaşımıyla, her biri kendi alanında
uzmanlaşmış profesyonel ekipleriyle, hastalarına güvenilir ve kaliteli sağlık hizmetleri
sunmaktadır. Sağlık turizmi vizyonuyla global ölçekte önemli bir oyuncu haline gelen ve
yatırımlarına devam eden Aktif International, Türkiye’yi uluslararası platformlarda gururla temsil
etmektedir.

Aktif International, sağlık alanında hasta merkezli yaklaşımıyla en iyi hizmeti hedefleyerek, çağdaş
ve bilimsel tedavi yöntemlerini, uluslararası düzeyde hastalarına sunmaktadır. Aktif International
güven, güler yüz ve hasta memnuniyetini temel alan yaklaşımıyla, beş farklı hastaneyi zaman
içerisinde bünyesine katarak Marmara Bölgesinde öne çıkan sağlık kuruluşlarından biri haline
gelmiştir.

Aktif International Hastaneler Grubu’nun yolculuğu, 1999 yılında Özel Yalova Uzmanlar Hastanesi’nin
kuruluşu ile başlamıştır. 2010 yılında Özel Yalova Aktif Hastanesi’nin ve daha sonra 1998 yılında
Yunus Emre Hastanesi adıyla kurulup 2020 yılında Hürrem Sultan Hastanesi ismini alan üçüncü
hastanemizin katılımıyla devam etmiştir. 2009 yılında kurulan Özel Kocaeli Hastanesi 2021 yılında
Özel Aktif Kocaeli Hastanesi ismiyle ve İstanbul Bahçelievler’deki Vital Hospital ise 2022 yılında
hastane grubu bünyesine katılmıştır. Bu son iki hastanenin de katılımıyla toplamda 5 hastane 2023
yılında Aktif International adıyla tek bir şemsiye altında toplanmıştır.

Aktif International tüm hastane ve kliniklerinde yaklaşık 2000 kişilik bir sağlık ordusuyla, modern
tıbbın gerektirdiği tüm teknolojik alt yapı ve modern tedavi yaklaşımıyla, her biri kendi alanında
uzmanlaşmış profesyonel ekipleriyle, hastalarına güvenilir ve kaliteli sağlık hizmetleri
sunmaktadır. Sağlık turizmi vizyonuyla global ölçekte önemli bir oyuncu haline gelen ve
yatırımlarına devam eden Aktif International, Türkiye’yi uluslararası platformlarda gururla temsil
etmektedir.

# Amicus Clinic — Plastic Surgery in Trivandrum, Kerala

[Dr. Unnikrishnan S, plastic surgeon at Amicus Clinic, Trivandrum]
Dr. Unnikrishnan S, MCh — Plastic Surgeon
ISAPS | IAAPS | Rhinoplasty Society of India
*Amicus means friend. *
**If you are reading this, something has probably been on your mind for a while.**

It could be something you have wanted to change for years, or something more recent. Either way, it
is a personal decision, and we respect that. Many people who come to us feel a mix of wanting this
and being unsure about it at the same time. That is normal. You are not the only one. Our job is not
to convince you. It is to help you think it through clearly, and if you do go ahead, to make sure it
is done safely and honestly — with someone who actually cares how it turns out.

**Before you decide. 
**Two things worth thinking about.**

1. Why do you want this?**
There is no wrong reason. It could be for a specific occasion, or something you have quietly carried
for a long time, or simply wanting to feel more like yourself. Whatever it is, talking it through
with someone you trust helps — a friend, a family member, or us.
**2. What would a good result look like for you?**
Surgery can do a lot, but it cannot do everything. We will tell you honestly what is achievable for
your situation and what is not. If we think a procedure is not right for you, we will say so.

**How we work**
Two types of procedures we do, 

**Smaller procedures** 
Things like scar revision, mole removal, small swellings. Local anesthesia. You go home the same
day. Most people are back to light work the next day.

**Bigger procedures** 
Things like gynecomastia correction, rhinoplasty, breast augmentation and reduction, liposuction,
and abdominoplasty (tummy tuck). These need general anesthesia and a short hospital stay. Recovery
takes longer, but we'll walk you through every step.
We'll help you understand which option fits your situation—and what to expect before, during, and
after.

About the Surgeon

## Dr. Farhad *Rafizadeh*

Board certified in both General Surgery and Plastic Surgery by the American Board of Plastic
Surgery, Dr. Rafizadeh has practiced in Morristown, NJ since 1984. A Fellow of the American College
of Surgeons (FACS) and active member of the American Society of Plastic Surgeons (ASPS) and the
International Society of Aesthetic Plastic Surgery (ISAPS), he has been recognized as a Castle
Connolly Top Doctor and NJ Monthly Top Surgeon year after year.

Before becoming a surgeon, he was an artist. That innate sense of proportion, harmony, and the
golden ratio informs every procedure he performs — delivering results that look natural, not
operated. His patients — most of them in their 50s, 60s, and 70s — describe the goal the same way:
*“refreshed, not different”* — you, just rested. That philosophy of conservative, natural
rejuvenation has defined the practice for four decades. Learn more about Dr. Rafizadeh, a board
certified [plastic surgeon in NJ][10] serving Morristown and northern New Jersey.

### *Facelift*

Dr. Rafizadeh is among a select group of surgeons in the New York–New Jersey region who performs the
deep plane facelift as his primary facial rejuvenation technique. Unlike the superficial SMAS
facelift, the deep plane approach releases facial ligaments at their root, restoring volume, lifting
the midface, and producing results that look decades younger — without the "pulled" appearance.

About the Surgeon

## Dr. Farhad *Rafizadeh*

Board certified in both General Surgery and Plastic Surgery by the American Board of Plastic
Surgery, Dr. Rafizadeh has practiced in Morristown, NJ since 1984. A Fellow of the American College
of Surgeons (FACS) and active member of the American Society of Plastic Surgeons (ASPS) and the
International Society of Aesthetic Plastic Surgery (ISAPS), he has been recognized as a Castle
Connolly Top Doctor and NJ Monthly Top Surgeon year after year.

Before becoming a surgeon, he was an artist. That innate sense of proportion, harmony, and the
golden ratio informs every procedure he performs — delivering results that look natural, not
operated. His patients — most of them in their 50s, 60s, and 70s — describe the goal the same way:
*“refreshed, not different”* — you, just rested. That philosophy of conservative, natural
rejuvenation has defined the practice for four decades. Learn more about Dr. Rafizadeh, a board
certified [plastic surgeon in NJ][10] serving Morristown and northern New Jersey.

### *Facelift*

Dr. Rafizadeh is among a select group of surgeons in the New York–New Jersey region who performs the
deep plane facelift as his primary facial rejuvenation technique. Unlike the superficial SMAS
facelift, the deep plane approach releases facial ligaments at their root, restoring volume, lifting
the midface, and producing results that look decades younger — without the "pulled" appearance.

## Breast Augmentation

Enhance the size, shape, and symmetry of your breasts with breast augmentation surgery at bŏdze in
Tampa. Using implants, this procedure helps restore fullness and balance, boosting confidence with
natural-looking results.

[Breast Augmentation Info][73]
[Breast Augmentation][74]

## Tummy Tuck

Tummy Tuck surgery, also known as Abdominoplasty surgery, removes excess skin and fat while
tightening abdominal muscles for a firmer, flatter stomach. This procedure is ideal after weight
loss to restore a contoured, confident profile.

[Tummy Tuck Info][75]
[Abdominoplasty (Tummy Tuck)][76]

## Brazilian Butt Lift (BBL)

A Brazilian Butt Lift surgery (BBL) combines liposuction with fat transfer to enhance the shape and
volume of the buttocks. This procedure creates a fuller, more balanced silhouette while naturally
sculpting your waist and midsection.

[BBL Info][77]
[Brazilian Butt Lift (BBL)][78]

## Liposuction 360

Lipo 360 surgery sculpts the entire midsection, targeting the abdomen, obliques, and lower back, for
a more defined silhouette. This comprehensive body contouring procedure is perfect for achieving a
slimmer, more proportionate shape.

area. Her skills as a surgeon are supported by an experienced staff that has been well-trained to
recognize and respect the rights of her patients while providing a pleasant, safe and caring
environment.

# One of the UK's Leading Cosmetic Surgery Clinics

Cosmetic Surgery Partners is a London-based clinic offering surgical and aesthetic treatments.

Our specialisms in [**breast surgery**][90] include breast augmentation, breast reduction, breast
uplift surgeries and inverted nipple correction. We are widely recognised for our work in
[**surgical procedures for the body**][91], including liposuction, abdominoplasty (tummy tuck),
labiaplasty and gender-affirming surgeries.

Our leading [**facial cosmetic surgery**][92] work includes rhinoplasty, face lifts and
blepharoplasty (eyelid surgery), cheek implants, jaw surgery and neck lifts.

We also offer [**minor cosmetic procedures**][93] and [**non-surgical treatments**][94], including
DHI hair transplants, dermal and lip fillers and advanced skincare.

Our practice is guided by our commitment to world-leading patient care, earning us many [**awards
for excellence**][95].

Discover our [full range of surgical procedures.][96]

needs. We take time to get to know you and your goals and guide you through every step at our London
clinic.

coordinators, nurses and aestheticians and the expert surgeons, we take pride in our total care.

stress et la pollution sont des facteurs favorisant la chute. Si le phénomène touche plus
fréquemment les hommes, les femmes peuvent aussi y être sujettes, provoquant un véritable mal-être.

La découverte et le développement de la greffe de cheveux, que l’on appelle encore implant
capillaire a révolutionné la chirurgie esthétique de la calvitie et permet d’obtenir des résultats
optimaux et naturels.

# CHIRURGIE ESTHÉTIQUE ET PLASTIQUE À GENÈVE ET LAUSANNE

## DOCTEUR JEAN-CHARLES BAYOL

Le Dr Jean-Charles Bayol est[ qualifié par la Fédération Médicale Helvétique en Chirurgie Plastique,
Reconstructive et Esthétique][56] et diplômé de l’Université Paris VI.

Depuis plus de 10 ans il met à votre service ses compétences et son expérience, tout
particulièrement en chirurgie et médecine esthétique et anti-âge du visage, de la calvitie, mais
aussi de la silhouette et de la poitrine en Suisse.

Praticien passionné par son métier et engagé dans la recherche scientifique, le Dr Bayol est à la
pointe des progrès techniques utilisés en médecine et chirurgie esthétique et vous assure ainsi une
prise en charge d’excellence.

## VOTRE PRISE EN CHARGE

[Image Prise en charge]

### ACCOMPAGNEMENT ET CONFIDENTIALITÉ

Le Docteur Jean-Charles Bayol met son talent et son savoir-faire au service des plus prestigieux
centres médicaux et cliniques Suisse:

*Ce site est fait pour vous. Vous pourrez y trouver toutes mes explications sur les interventions de
[**chirurgie esthétique**][57] réalisées en Suisse : la [**chirurgie esthétique du visage**][58]
(lifting, rhinoplastie, blépharoplastie), la [**chirurgie mammaire**][59] (implants mammaires,
réduction, lifting des seins, injections de graisse), la [**chirurgie esthétique de la
silhouette**][60] (liposuccion, abdominoplastie), ou encore les [**greffes de cheveux**][61] et les
implants capillaires. Vous trouverez également des informations et conseils sur la médecine
esthétique et anti-âge (toxine botulique, acide hyaluronique, peelings, laser et cryolipolyse).*

*Je vous souhaite une bonne visite et à bientôt.*

## CHIRURGIE ESTHÉTIQUE

[Image Chrirurgie Plastique]

### CHIRURGIE PLASTIQUE, RECONSTRUCTIVE
### ET ESTHÉTIQUE

Embellir son apparence physique, rajeunir, masquer une imperfection ou mettre fin à un complexe…
Nombreuses sont les raisons qui conduisent aux actes de chirurgie esthétiques. Parce que cette
décision n’est pas anodine et pour que le résultat vous apporte le mieux-être escompté, le Docteur
Jean-Charles Bayol vous aide à mûrir votre projet et vous accompagne tout au long du processus.

Qu’il s’agisse du visage, de la poitrine ou de la silhouette, les techniques de chirurgie esthétique
prônées et employées par le Docteur Jean-Charles Bayol sont douces, naturelles, efficaces et
garantissent un résultat durable et harmonieux.

## MÉDECINE ESTHÉTIQUE ET ANTI-ÂGE

[Image Medecine Esthetique Et Anti-age]

### INTERVENTIONS LÉGÈRES ET RÉSULTATS NATURELS

Les soins de médecine esthétique et anti-âge retardent l’effet du temps. Ils permettent d’atténuer
les rides et les ridules, d’améliorer l’éclat de la peau, de redonner du volume au visage…

Simples, légers et doux, les soins prodigués par le Docteur Jean-Charles Bayol sont efficaces et le
fruit des dernières technologies et avancées médicales.

## CHEVEUX

[Image Cheveux]

### RÉSULTATS GARANTIS ET DÉFINITIFS

La perte de cheveux a le plus souvent une cause génétique et hormonale. Cependant, le tabac, le
stress et la pollution sont des facteurs favorisant la chute. Si le phénomène touche plus
fréquemment les hommes, les femmes peuvent aussi y être sujettes, provoquant un véritable mal-être.

La découverte et le développement de la greffe de cheveux, que l’on appelle encore implant
capillaire a révolutionné la chirurgie esthétique de la calvitie et permet d’obtenir des résultats
optimaux et naturels.

## Dr. Scott Brenman

###### Board Certified Plastic Surgeon & Founder of The Pennsylvania Centre for Plastic Surgery

Dr. Scott A. Brenman is a **Board-Certified Plastic Surgeon** and a Fellow of the American College
of Surgeons. He received his MD with honors from Jefferson Medical College in Philadelphia, PA.

After completing medical school, Dr. Brenman continued his surgical training at Pennsylvania
Hospital with a five-year residency in General Surgery. Dr. Brenman completed his Residency in
Plastic Surgery with two and a half years at Duke University Medical Center. A Hand and Microsurgery
Fellowship at the University of Louisville followed the residency.

He is a clinical instructor in plastic surgery and is actively involved with the teaching of
residents and medical students from Temple University and the University of Pennsylvania.

Dr. Scott Brenman has also been honored as a “Top Doc” by the Philadelphia Magazine as one of the
region’s best plastic surgeons for women.

## Why Choose Dr. Ali Plastic Surgery

Dr. Ali Plastic Surgery & AMAE Med Spa is the Detroit area’s one stop for the widest array of
cosmetic surgeries and state-of-the-art, non-invasive aesthetic treatments. Our highly qualified
staff offers the most advanced surgical procedures such as breast enhancement, tummy tucks,
liposuction, facelifts, rhinoplasty (nose jobs), mommy makeovers, and more.

We also offer the latest non-surgical fat loss, skin tightening, and anti aging treatments,
including CoolSculpting, Botox, Juvéderm, Microneedling, and Profound & C02RE laser skin
rejuvenation.

Dr. Ali is one of the Detroit area’s top plastic surgeons. It is his belief that patient education
and realistic expectation are the key to the success of any plastic surgery procedure. He will take
the time to get to know you, listen to your appearance concerns, understand your aesthetic goals,
and provide you with the information and options to make the best decisions regarding the procedures
that are right for you.

that are right for you.

and comfort. He carefully designs each treatment plan to achieve results that enhance your natural
beauty without appearing artificial. At his practice, you will find a calming and discreet
environment where patient satisfaction and ethical medical care are paramount.

# Sergio Zamora, MD, FACS

### Board Certified Plastic Surgeon

Welcome to the practice of Dr. Sergio M. Zamora, MD, FACS, where compassionate care meets
exceptional skill and experience. Dr. Zamora, a board-certified plastic surgeon and Fellow of the
American College of Surgeons, has dedicated his career to helping patients in Daytona Beach, New
Smyrna Beach, and surrounding Florida communities achieve their aesthetic goals with results that
are natural-looking and refined.

With a comprehensive medical background, Dr. Zamora’s expertise spans both surgical procedures and
medical spa treatments. His extensive training includes a plastic surgery residency at the
University of Utah, where he served as Chief Resident, along with a general surgery residency and
research fellowship at the University of South Carolina’s Richland Memorial Hospital. Dr. Zamora’s
journey in medicine began with earning his Doctor of Medicine degree from the Autonomous University
of Guadalajara, Mexico.

Dr. Zamora’s approach combines precision, artistry, and an unwavering commitment to patient safety
and comfort. He carefully designs each treatment plan to achieve results that enhance your natural
beauty without appearing artificial. At his practice, you will find a calming and discreet
environment where patient satisfaction and ethical medical care are paramount.

## Concepts

FAC Centers for Aesthetic Medicine is proud to have been serving the Orange County and Los Angeles
area since 1980. FAC is an award-winning cosmetic surgery center with our double-board certified
facial plastic and plastic surgeons who are exclusively trained in facial, breast, and body plastic
surgery. Facial plastic surgery, which includes a facelift, micro-lifts, browlift, blepharoplasty,
rhinoplasty, otoplasty, and “Mommy Makeovers,” are some of the core competencies of our surgical
team.

[About the practice][80]

## Facial Plastic Surgery

FAC Centers for Aesthetic Medicine is the premier practice in Orange County for facial plastic
surgery. With over two decades of experience, the practice pairs innovation with experience. Every
procedure, whether it be a facelift, rhinoplasty, eyelid surgery, or even non-surgical treatments,
is expertly performed by some of the top aesthetic artists in the country. The procedures performed
at our practice are individually tailored to fit the patient’s unique needs. There is a reason why
thousands of patients have chosen FAC for facial plastic surgery, and we hope to help you achieve a
youthful, refined, and refreshed appearance.

## Injectables

FAC Centers for Aesthetic Medicine offers a variety of injectables to enhance the patient’s
natural beauty. As leaders in aesthetics and pioneers in facial plastic surgery, we understand the
complexity of facial aging. Our highly trained team designs treatments with every patient’s unique
goals in mind. Be it BOTOX to smooth out fine lines and wrinkles, or dermal fillers to provide a
more youthful appearance and add volume where age may have stolen it away, we’ll work with you to
achieve long-lasting results that will improve symmetry and improve facial balance.

[View all Injectables][87]

[ [home-botox]

### BOTOX® & Neuromodulators

BOTOX® and Neuromodulators are popular, non-surgical treatments designed to smooth out wrinkles and
fine lines. They target areas like crow’s feet, frown lines, and forehead wrinkles, offering a more
youthful, refreshed appearance. These treatments are quick, with minimal downtime, allowing you to
return to your daily activities right away. Our experienced team will work with you to create a
personalized plan that delivers the most natural and effective results. Discover how BOTOX® and
neuromodulators can enhance your look today!

][88]
[ [homepage-dermal-filler]

### Dermal Fillers

Dermal fillers at FAC Centers for Aesthetic Medicine offer clients a quick and effective solution to
restore volume to their faces and smooth out pesky wrinkles. These treatments can enhance lips, lift
sagging cheeks, and soften fine lines, giving you that refreshed, youthful appearance you’ve been
looking for. Our team customizes every filler treatment to your unique goals for a personalized
approach with minimal downtime. If you’re ready to restore your facial volume and smooth wrinkles
for a rejuvenated, natural look, call our office!

][89]
[ [home-fillers]

### Lip Fillers

Lip fillers are a fantastic way to perfect your lips by adding volume, shape, and definition for a
fuller, more youthful look. Whether you’re looking for subtle enhancements or a more dramatic
change, our lip fillers provide a customizable solution. At Facial Aesthetic Concepts, we use
high-quality dermal fillers to achieve natural, smooth results tailored to your unique features. The
treatment is a quick in-and-out session with minimal downtime and delivers noticeable results that
can boost your confidence and leave you with beautifully enhanced lips.

][90]
[ [home-rhinoplasty]

### Liquid Rhinoplasty

Liquid rhinoplasty is a non-surgical option for enhancing the shape of your nose with minimal
downtime. Using our injectable fillers, we can smooth out bumps, lift the tip, and improve the
symmetry of your nose for a more refined profile. At Facial Aesthetic Concepts in Orange County, our
experts carefully customize each treatment to match your natural features, ensuring subtle,
beautiful results. It’s an effective way to reshape your nose without surgery or a lengthy recovery
period.

## Welcome to **MACS Clinic**

MACS clinic is a unique clinic that offers specialised services, which are led by a team of senior
Consultants that have worked extensively in the NHS and private healthcare.
If you are tired of the long waiting lists or are unable to get treatment in your local area, MACS
Clinic offers you the choice to be treated at your convenience.
We believe in providing tailor-made treatment and invite you to explore our personalised services.

###### Our Highlights
* Video consultations offered (free for Cosmetic enquiries) and minimum waiting time for
  investigations and treatments.
* Situated in the heart of Watford city centre.
* Our clinic timings are from 9.30am to 5.30pm on week days and 9am to 5.30pm on Saturdays.
* Walking distance from train stations and car parking facilities.
* CQC registered and outstanding patient reviews.

###### About Dr. Sarah A. Cazorla

## Experience and Excellence

Dr Cazorla is an artist at heart. She is able to apply her skill, precision, and artistic eye to
develop a treatment plan that is unique to each of her patients. Her work allows the patient’s
natural beauty to shine through.

As a woman and mother of two she is particularly passionate about helping women redefine their
bodies after childbirth. This “mommy makeover” is a collection of surgical options that can be
taylored to each patient’s specific needs to help restore their bodies.
* Dr. Cazorla is a Board Certified Plastic Surgeon
* Dr. Cazorla is a Fellow of the American College of Surgeons and an active member of the American
  Society of Plastic Surgeons

manufacturing, and distribution of patented therapies for advanced wound care, scar management, and
skin care. We understand both the physical and psychological impact of wounds and the scars they
create and are dedicated to supplying medical professionals with new solutions to improve the
quality of life for patients.

AESTHETICS

# Our Specialty is liposuction.

Most patients want to have liposuction done by a doctor who specializes in this procedure because
daily, ongoing practice at sculpting the body allows the doctor to develop an experienced eye and a
singularly skilled hand.

Phoenix Liposuction Center™ is one of the rare cosmetic surgery practices in Phoenix, AZ that
specialize exclusively in performing liposuction surgery. Lead by Dr. William Hall and Dr. William
Shuell, Phoenix Liposuction Center™™ has administered an accredited liposuction training course that
offers advanced training techniques to other physicians from all over the world. You’re in the hands
of experts.


##### Questions & More

##### What is liposuction?

Liposuction is the removal of fat cells from the body by suction assisted surgery. Liposuction is
normally performed to re-contour the body and cosmetically improve the patient’s appearance by
suctioning out stubborn fatty bulges that cling to the body that have remained even after the
patient has tried to diet and exercise. Liposuction is a minimally-invasive fat-extraction method
and at Phoenix Liposuction Center™, we use an Awake Lipo method that uses only local anesthesia and
mild sedation, so the risks associated with the surgery are lower. Cosmetic surgeons Dr. William
Hall and Dr. William Shuell gently suction fat out of the body through tiny incisions using an
extremely thin tube. Our special surgical sculpting and contouring technique is known as
micro-liposuction and has a very high-level of precision.

##### How much does liposuction cost?

Liposuction cost can vary greatly depending on the patient; however, an average size woman 5’2” and
135 lbs. who desires her abdomen to be reduced can expect the following:
* $4000.oo
* This is approximate of course and based on the amount of fat in the treated areas. Price would
  fluctuate 10-15% up or down based on smaller or larger than average.
* If this same woman desires to add her waist/hips (mid-section) to the same surgery, only add
  $1000-$1500 more so a total of approximately $5300.
* As you can see the pricing gets progressively less as you add areas during the same procedure.
* All of the pricing is done on an individual basis when Dr. Hall or Dr. Shuell personally meets
  with you.

Here at Phoenix Liposuction Center™ we only engage patients with simple, straightforward surgical
quotes. We also do not utilize high-pressure sales tactics or follow up phone calls.

##### Do you offer financing?

Absolutely! At Phoenix Liposuction Center™, we offer several different financing options to make it
easier for our patients to afford all of the benefits of liposculpture. Our clinic has strong
relationships with reputable finance companies that regularly help our patients by offering both
advice and financial assistance.

Many of our patients are surprised by the affordability of liposuction surgery at Phoenix
Liposuction Center™, particularly when they explore our financing options. Financing applications
take only a few minutes to complete. The process is easy and afterwards, patients make affordable
monthly payments.

### Proven Safer than Implants

Natural tissue reconstruction avoids the long-term risks associated with implants, including
rupture, capsular contracture, and repeat surgeries. Studies show higher complication rates with
implants, which is why PRMA is committed to offering a safer, longer-lasting reconstruction option
using your own tissue.
[natural looking]

### High-Definition Natural Results

Our High Def DIEP® technique delivers refined contouring and natural breast shape using your own
tissue. The result is a softer, more natural appearance that looks and feels like you, not a
reconstruction.
[specialists]

### Specialists in Complex & Revision Cases

PRMA is nationally recognized for treating patients with failed or painful implant reconstructions.
We specialize in converting implant-based reconstructions to natural tissue solutions when others
say it cannot be done.

### Care That Treats the Whole Woman

Healing after breast cancer is physical and emotional. Our patient-centered approach focuses on
restoring confidence, dignity, and wholeness, not just reconstructing breasts.

## Dr. Papafragkou

Board Certified Plastic Surgeon

Sotirios Papafragkou, MD, FACS, is a triple board-certified surgeon at Plastic Surgery Associates of
Long Island in Roslyn Heights, New York. Dr. Papafragkou is board-certified in plastic surgery, hand
and microvascular surgery, and general surgery. He is an active member of the American Society for
Surgery of the Hand (ASSH), the American Society of Plastic Surgeons (ASPS), and the Aesthetic
Society (ASAPS).

[Meet Dr. Papafragkou][67]

## Dr. Rhee

Board Certified Plastic Surgeon

Susie Rhee, MD, is a board-certified female plastic surgeon at Plastic Surgery Associates of Long
Island in Roslyn Heights, New York. Dr. Rhee is based in Nassau County, New York, but serves all of
Long Island. She is a dedicated patient advocate whose priorities include patient safety,
satisfaction, and excellence in clinical care.

[Meet Dr. Rhee][68]

##### เปิดให้บริการมาตั้งแต่ปี 1999

ดูแลคุณด้วยหัวใจ โดยทีมแพทย์ พยาบาล และเจ้าหน้าที่ ให้คุณมั่นใจในทุกขั้นตอน

##### ได้รับคะแนนรับรอง จาก AACI

รางวัล AACI Excellences Award 2025 ตอกย้ำมาตรฐานที่คุณมั่นใจได้ตั้งแต่ก้าวแรก

##### ผู้รับบริการกว่า 52 ประเทศทั่วโลกไว้วางใจ

ความเชื่อมันระดับนานาชาติ ภายใต้มาตรฐานการดูแลเท่าเทียมกัน

##### คลินิกสะอาดและเป็นส่วนตัว

บรรยากาศที่สะอาด เงียบสงบ และเป็นส่วนตัว ให้คุณรู้สึกผ่อนคลายทุกครั้ง

##### ปรึกษาแพทย์ ฟรี

ให้คำแนะนำโดยแพทย์เฉพาะทาง วิเคราะห์อย่างละเอียด รับฟังอย่างใส่ใจ

##### รับการ Prescreen ฟรี

วางแผนการดูแลเฉพาะคุณแบบ 360° ด้วยเครื่อง 3D Scan, อัลตราซาวด์ และ BMI

##### Aftercare ครบทุกขั้นตอน

มอบบริการดูแลหลังทำ เพื่อช่วยให้คุณฟื้นตัวได้อย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ

##### อุปกรณ์-เทคโนโลยีล้ำสมัย ผ่านมาตรฐาน

เราคัดสรรอุปกรณ์ทางการแพทย์ที่ได้รับการรับรองมาตรฐาน อย. ไทย และ US FDA

##### ดูแลโดยวิสัญญีแพทย์ตลอดการรักษา

วิสัญญีแพทย์ดูแล แบบ 1:1 อย่างใกล้ชิดเพื่อการการฟื้นตัวและคืนสติอย่างปลอดภัย

##### เทคนิคลดความเจ็บปวด 3 ระดับ เพื่อความสบายสูงสุด

เทคนิคการให้ยาชาหลายระดับเพื่อให้เหมาะสมกับแต่ละหัตถการ

##### เทคนิคยาชา Pure Tumescent ลดความเจ็บปวด

เทคนิค Pure Tumescent ในการให้ยาชา เพื่อช่วยลดความเจ็บปวดในการทำหัตถการ

##### เทคนิคยาชา Painless Pump ลดความเจ็บและปลอดภัย

เทคนิค Painless Pump ช่วยลดความเจ็บปวดในช่วงพักฟื้น

##### ราคาชัดเจน ไม่ชาร์จเพิ่มทีหลัง

นำเสนอราคาชัดเจน ไม่มีค่าธรรมเนียมแอบแฝง หรือค่าใช้จ่ายเพิ่มเติมที่ไม่เป็นธรรม

##### การดูแลอย่างครอบคลุม พร้อมติดตามผลระยะยาว

มอบการดูแลหลังการรักษาอย่างต่อเนื่อง พร้อมติดตามผลให้คุณมั่นใจในผลลัพธ์

##### ทีมแพทย์ของรัตตินันท์ คลินิก

แพทย์เฉพาะทางมากประสบการณ์ในแต่ละด้าน พร้อมผสานศาสตร์การแพทย์กับเทคโนโลยี

  * Temporary improvement in the appearance of cellulite;

# INDICATION
* The **radiofrequency energy only delivery components of the Thermage system** and accessories are
  indicated for use in:
  * Dermatologic and general surgical procedures for electrocoagulation and hemostasis;
  * Non-invasive treatment of periorbital wrinkles and rhytids including upper and lower eyelids;
    and
  * Non-invasive treatment of wrinkles and rhytids.
* The **simultaneous application of radiofrequency energy and skin vibration by the Thermage
  system** and accessories are indicated for use in:
  * Dermatologic and general surgical procedures for electrocoagulation and hemostasis;
  * Non-invasive treatment of periorbital wrinkles and rhytids;
  * Non-invasive treatment of wrinkles and rhytids;
  * Temporary improvement in the appearance of cellulite;
  * Relief of minor muscle aches and pains;
  * Relief of muscle spasms; and
  * Temporary improvement of local circulation (blood circulation).

# Because Your Well-Being Deserves the Best Care

** Where confidence and health come together.**

At IBI Clinic Tampa, we specialize in advanced weight loss, laser procedures, and aesthetic
procedures that change lives, not just appearances. Backed by cutting-edge technology and expert
surgical care, we put your safety first while delivering results you’ll love.

**Personalized care, proven results**

We are the premier destination for advanced weight loss and aesthetic procedures. With
state-of-the-art technology and expert specialists, we ensure your safety while delivering results
that restore health, confidence, and quality of life.

[Meet the Team Behind Your Care][15]

[ Book a Consultation ][16]
[Dr Chris ibikunle][Dr Chris ibikunle]

# What We Offer

Uncover a healthier, more confident version of yourself with our wide array of services tailored to
transform your life.

[Medical Weight Loss Services][Medical Weight Loss Services]

Medical Weight Loss Program

Medical weight loss aids higher-weight patients in improving health and sustaining long-term weight
loss under medical supervision.

[Aesthetics Services][Aesthetics Services]

Aesthetic & MED Spa

Restore a youthful appearance by reducing wrinkles, enhancing contours, and adding volume to
targeted areas for a smoother, rejuvenated look.

[IV Therapy Services][IV Therapy Services]

Hydration and Recovery Solutions

Quickly and efficiently replenish your body with hydration, essential vitamins, and minerals to
address nutrient deficiencies and support your overall well-being.

[Weight Loss Tampa][Weight Loss Tampa]

Surgical Weight Loss

Common obesity surgeries like gastric bypass, sleeve gastrectomy, and banding reduce food intake or
absorption to aid weight loss.

[Weight Loss][Weight Loss]

Non-Surgical Weight Loss

Spatz, Orbera Balloons & ESG offer incision-free procedures with no hospital stay and faster
recovery than surgery.

[Laser][Laser]

Laser Procedures

We specialize in advanced laser treatments, offering minimally invasive solutions for Fistulas,
Fissures, Cysts, and Hemorrhoids.

## Meet the surgeon

Mr Vijayan is a board certified Consultant Plastic Surgeon. He qualified from medical school in
London in 2008 with a first class intercalated degree in Endocrinology (hormonal and metabolic
health), and subsequently worked in over 20 hospitals during his training, spanning London,
Oxfordshire and Sussex. After general post-graduate training in medicine and surgery, he undertook
specialist training in plastic surgery at the Queen Victoria hospital, Royal London hospital, Royal
Free hospital, Chelsea & Westminster hospital, and Guys & St Thomas’ hospital.

This culminated in a sub-specialty fellowship period, before taking up a Consultant Plastic Surgeon
NHS post in Stevenage.

During his career he has published academic papers, presented nationally and internationally, and he
continues to play an active role in training the next generation of surgeons. He has visited
prestigious plastic surgery units at home and abroad, including South Korea and Taiwan, in order to
broaden his expertise.

His lifelong interest in wellness, fitness and sustainable living shapes his aesthetic practice. He
believes in natural, well balanced and proportioned results, where surgery complements health and
confidence. He is naturally creative, and well respected for his artistry, clear communication and
down to earth demeanour.

## **Precision, ****Care, ****Integrity**

Mr Roshan Vijayan is an experienced Consultant Plastic Surgeon, with broad specialist training. With
a commitment to wellness and sustainable living, he emphasises natural, well-balanced results in his
aesthetic practice. Renowned for his artistry and clear communication, Mr Vijayan is dedicated to
training the next generation of surgeons and committed to his values of Precision, Care and
Integrity.

Precision
Care
Integrity

Surgery is a technical craft that requires an eye for detail, and high standards. I believe in
careful planning, as I would before undertaking an artwork. Most of the hard work is done before
picking up the scalpel, to visualise the final aesthetic, plan the approach, pre-empt any pitfalls,
and rehearse the steps.

I care about you as a patient, and my own performance.

Care incorporates your total experience, from your first visit, to your surgery, and after care. My
aim is to put you at ease, understand what you want, explain myself as clearly as possible and check
that you are happy. Then deliver results.

I take pride in communication, ensuring that you have as much information and support as you need. I
summarise all consultations in detailed letters, that serve as a recap for you, and help you
prepare. I always aim to be accessible either directly via email or through my admin team.

I see surgery as a partnership rather than as something I do to you. For a short time, you entrust
yourself to me and the operating theatre team, but for the most part it is a shared endeavour where
your views and understanding are crucial.

One of the great things about the UK is the National Health Service, which despite its challenges,
remains largely free at the point of use. This means that you can be confident that your doctor is
never incentivised to over-investigate or over-treat you, for financial gain. The result is
generally sensible, cost-effective decision making, with your best interests at heart.

Unfortunately the same is not always true in private healthcare, where the prospect of financial
reward can lead to gaming patients.

I am motivated primarily by the creative act of surgery, and the reward of great results. I
therefore pledge to:
* Always give you an honest impartial opinion
* Only recommend necessary tests and appointments
* Not suggest or recommend treatments which I do not believe are in your best interests
* Give you the option to transfer your care into the NHS if feasible and if you wish, for example
  for cancer follow-up
* Treat you as I would a relative or friend

## Meet the surgeon

Mr Vijayan is a board certified Consultant Plastic Surgeon. He qualified from medical school in
London in 2008 with a first class intercalated degree in Endocrinology (hormonal and metabolic
health), and subsequently worked in over 20 hospitals during his training, spanning London,
Oxfordshire and Sussex. After general post-graduate training in medicine and surgery, he undertook
specialist training in plastic surgery at the Queen Victoria hospital, Royal London hospital, Royal
Free hospital, Chelsea & Westminster hospital, and Guys & St Thomas’ hospital.

This culminated in a sub-specialty fellowship period, before taking up a Consultant Plastic Surgeon
NHS post in Stevenage.

During his career he has published academic papers, presented nationally and internationally, and he
continues to play an active role in training the next generation of surgeons. He has visited
prestigious plastic surgery units at home and abroad, including South Korea and Taiwan, in order to
broaden his expertise.

His lifelong interest in wellness, fitness and sustainable living shapes his aesthetic practice. He
believes in natural, well balanced and proportioned results, where surgery complements health and
confidence. He is naturally creative, and well respected for his artistry, clear communication and
down to earth demeanour.

[Read More][38]

* MBBS Imperial College London

 
* MRCS (Eng), Member of the Royal College of Surgeons in England

* Executive MBA

## **Precision, ****Care, ****Integrity**

Mr Roshan Vijayan is an experienced Consultant Plastic Surgeon, with broad specialist training. With
a commitment to wellness and sustainable living, he emphasises natural, well-balanced results in his
aesthetic practice. Renowned for his artistry and clear communication, Mr Vijayan is dedicated to
training the next generation of surgeons and committed to his values of Precision, Care and
Integrity.

Precision
Care
Integrity

Surgery is a technical craft that requires an eye for detail, and high standards. I believe in
careful planning, as I would before undertaking an artwork. Most of the hard work is done before
picking up the scalpel, to visualise the final aesthetic, plan the approach, pre-empt any pitfalls,
and rehearse the steps.

I care about you as a patient, and my own performance.

Care incorporates your total experience, from your first visit, to your surgery, and after care. My
aim is to put you at ease, understand what you want, explain myself as clearly as possible and check
that you are happy. Then deliver results.

I take pride in communication, ensuring that you have as much information and support as you need. I
summarise all consultations in detailed letters, that serve as a recap for you, and help you
prepare. I always aim to be accessible either directly via email or through my admin team.

I see surgery as a partnership rather than as something I do to you. For a short time, you entrust
yourself to me and the operating theatre team, but for the most part it is a shared endeavour where
your views and understanding are crucial.

One of the great things about the UK is the National Health Service, which despite its challenges,
remains largely free at the point of use. This means that you can be confident that your doctor is
never incentivised to over-investigate or over-treat you, for financial gain. The result is
generally sensible, cost-effective decision making, with your best interests at heart.

Unfortunately the same is not always true in private healthcare, where the prospect of financial
reward can lead to gaming patients.

I am motivated primarily by the creative act of surgery, and the reward of great results. I
therefore pledge to:
* Always give you an honest impartial opinion
* Only recommend necessary tests and appointments
* Not suggest or recommend treatments which I do not believe are in your best interests
* Give you the option to transfer your care into the NHS if feasible and if you wish, for example
  for cancer follow-up
* Treat you as I would a relative or friend

## LASIK

### Rediscover Clear Vision

Tired of reaching for glasses or fumbling with contact lenses every morning? LASIK might be the
solution you've been searching for. Our LASIK procedure can correct nearsightedness, farsightedness,
and astigmatism, offering you the freedom to see clearly without the hassle of corrective eyewear.

Take our LASIK Self Test to see if you're a candidate for this life-changing procedure. Say goodbye
to blurry vision and hello to a brighter, clearer future.

[
Take LASIK Self Test
][60] [
Request LASIK Consultation
][61]

## **Refractive Lens Exchange (RLE)**

### Enhance Your Vision, Elevate Your Life

RLE is a surgical procedure that is very similar to cataract surgery. The eye's natural lens is
replaced with an artificial one, called an intraocular lens, or IOL. This procedure can act as **an
alternative to LASIK surgery **and can significantly improve the vision of those with
nearsightedness.

Refractive Lens Exchange is an excellent alternative for those who are not candidates for LASIK.
This popular procedure can not only drastically improve your vision, but can also prevent you from
developing cataracts!

Find out more about the qualities of a good candidate for RLE and if you are a candidate for this
procedure by contacting our office today!

[
Request an RLE Consultation
][62]

## **Cataract Surgery**

### See Clearly Again

Is cloudy vision making daily tasks a challenge? Our cataract surgery could be the key to restoring
your sight and improving your quality of life. With advancements in premium cataract lens upgrades,
we offer personalized solutions tailored to your unique needs.

Curious if cataracts are affecting your vision? Take our Cataract Self Test and discover if it's
time to regain your clarity.

### A history of quality ensured by domestic production

Yasui has manufactured medical device parts since the 1970s. In 2016, we branched out into medical
devices and OEM manufacturing.

We are actively seeking distributors in various regions of the world and we welcome direct inquiries
from physicians, other professionals, and media.

[ About Yasui ][13]

## Certified for Excellence

Yasui has earned ISO 9001 and ISO 13485 certifications. These serve as international standards of
management systems, guiding our constant pursuit of quality, safety, and objectivity.

### ISO 13485

Certifying our medical device manufacturing

### ISO 9001

Certifying our quality management system

## Why Doctors Trust Us

We pursue the highest standard of quality in response to doctors’ needs. Yasui is uncompromising in
offering products that are safe, reliable, and make doctors more effective and precise in their
work.

### Local production

Yasui medical products are designed and manufactured in Japan. This ensures full oversight of every
phase of production, reducing quality inconsistencies.

### Clinical oversight

The koplight™ lighted retractor was a surgeon's idea. We made it a reality. We confer with doctors
on R&D and respond to doctors' needs.

### Cooperative

Yasui's 90+ years of experience in materials development has required constant cooperation. We bring
this to our customers.

### Here for you

We maintain communication with distributors and physicians so doctors can use our products with
maximum efficacy and skill.

## Unmatched Quality, Never Offshored

[Yasui Japan factory, ISO 14664-1 class 8/100,000 cleanroom]

### A history of quality ensured by domestic production

Yasui has manufactured medical device parts since the 1970s. In 2016, we branched out into medical
devices and OEM manufacturing.

We are actively seeking distributors in various regions of the world and we welcome direct inquiries
from physicians, other professionals, and media.

[ About Yasui ][13]

## Certified for Excellence

Yasui has earned ISO 9001 and ISO 13485 certifications. These serve as international standards of
management systems, guiding our constant pursuit of quality, safety, and objectivity.

### ISO 13485

Certifying our medical device manufacturing

### ISO 9001

Certifying our quality management system

## Why Doctors Trust Us

We pursue the highest standard of quality in response to doctors’ needs. Yasui is uncompromising in
offering products that are safe, reliable, and make doctors more effective and precise in their
work.

### Local production

Yasui medical products are designed and manufactured in Japan. This ensures full oversight of every
phase of production, reducing quality inconsistencies.

### Clinical oversight

The koplight™ lighted retractor was a surgeon's idea. We made it a reality. We confer with doctors
on R&D and respond to doctors' needs.

### Cooperative

Yasui's 90+ years of experience in materials development has required constant cooperation. We bring
this to our customers.

### Here for you

We maintain communication with distributors and physicians so doctors can use our products with
maximum efficacy and skill.

## See koplight™ in action

## Precise light for your operating room

The made-in-Japan koplight™ brings efficiency, precision, and light to surgery in the US, Europe,
and all over the world. Find out more.

[ Take a product tour of koplight™ ][14]
